scope: NARROW — adds exactly one fail-closed condition and one negative fixture

provenance_of_the_finding.found_by: a negative fixture failing, not by review
provenance_of_the_finding.what_happened: fixture J's first run duplicated results[100], which for AAPL is a pre-market bar (134 precede the open). It landed in extended hours, no guard fired, and the fixture reported FAIL.
two_separate_facts: the fixture's injection was wrong — it is specified to duplicate a REGULAR source key — and has been corrected
extended_hours_bars genuinely has no uniqueness contract, which the failing run exposed

rejected_argument.argument: canonical raw integrity already PASSed, so a duplicated source bar cannot occur in practice
rejected_argument.why_rejected: that quietly relocates part of the builder's correctness into an upstream artifact. It makes the derived layer correct only while the ingest gate's guarantee holds, without recording that dependency anywhere. A uniqueness contract that exists only as a property of the input is not a contract.

added_fail_closed_condition.rule: duplicate raw source keys are FATAL
added_fail_closed_condition.why_no_deduplication: a duplicated raw bar means the source is not what the archive claims; silently resolving it destroys the evidence while producing output that looks fine

why_the_key_has_three_parts.reason: one research security can have two legitimate simultaneous trading lines. GEHC, SOLV and VLTO each traded a when-issued line and a regular-way line on the same session under different tickers — established by MASSIVE_SECURITY_LINEAGE_ANOMALY_QUALIFICATION_V1.
why_the_key_has_three_parts.consequence_of_two_part_key: correct data would fail closed, because coexistence would read as duplication
why_the_key_has_three_parts.target: one source line repeating one timestamp
why_the_key_has_three_parts.not_forbidden: distinct source lines sharing a minute

uniqueness_invariants_consolidated.SESSION_CLOSE_BOUNDARY: >1 eligible boundary bar per security-session => HOLD
uniqueness_invariants_consolidated.EXTENDED_HOURS: duplicate source key within the same source line => HOLD
uniqueness_invariants_consolidated.note: the first two already existed; the third is added here. They are stated together so no output class is left without a uniqueness contract.

added_negative_fixture.name: DUPLICATE_EXTENDED_SOURCE_KEY
added_negative_fixture.construction: take one CONFIRMED pre- or post-market source bar and duplicate that exact source row
added_negative_fixture.precondition: the fixture MUST first prove the chosen bar is genuinely an EXTENDED_HOURS_BAR before duplicating it
added_negative_fixture.why_the_precondition: fixture J failed precisely because it assumed the class of the bar it picked instead of verifying it; repeating that mistake in the fixture written to catch it would be absurd
added_negative_fixture.correct_implementation: raises the duplicate-extended-source-key guard => fixture PASSES

smoke_consequence.rule: the amendment changes the implementation, so the frozen rule applies in full
smoke_consequence.requires: a FULL smoke rerun from scratch under a new implementation hash
smoke_consequence.partial_rerun_forbidden: running only the new fixture is not sufficient

supersedes_for_production_authorization.recording_method: recorded here and in the successor smoke rather than by editing the sealed artifact, so its digest stays verifiable

unchanged_from_base: source restriction to original canonical raw
next_step: freeze the new implementation hash, rerun the FULL smoke (13 fixtures) from scratch, then independent verification. Production remains HOLD until that rerun PASSes.
